svg.text: Diffusion RL Post-Training - Miles/slime two-plane + SGLang-D rollout + FlowGRPO - github.com/radixark/miles_diffusion
L1 - Entry Points + Diffusion Model Families (experimental diffusion post-training fork of Miles)
L2 - Ray Orchestrator + GPU Placement (colocated actor + sglang-diffusion engine)
L3 - Two-Plane Core (Miles/slime decoupled train + rollout - diffusion adaptation)
--train-backend fsdp - DiT LoRA on diffusion backbone
Bridge between image rollout and FSDP train
rm_hub async reward: ocr / pickscore scoring
LoRA weight sync: actor FSDP to sglang-d DiT after each rollout epoch
L4 - Diffusion Rollout + Training Stack (SGLang-D API + FSDP DiT + log-prob alignment)
rollout_sde_type - ignore_last steps - no CFG train
L5 - FlowGRPO Algorithms + Vendored flow_grpo/ (online RL for flow matching models)
L6 - Reward Hub + Data (image-level scoring - not token logprob rewards)
Non-autoregressive RL: per-denoising-step log_probs + image-level reward signals
Step 1: rollout_manager.generate - SGLang-D POST /rollout/generate with rollout=True
Step 2: rm_hub batched_async_rm - OCR/PickScore reward on generated images
Step 3: Store DiT trajectory + per-timestep log_probs in rollout buffer (GRPO groups)
Step 4: actor_model.async_train - FSDP LoRA GRPO update with diffusion-clip-range + kl-beta
Step 5: actor_model.update_weights - sync LoRA to sglang-d - eval/save checkpoint - repeat
Example: SD3.5 OCR GRPO - 2 GPU colocate - 10 train steps / 40 eval steps - LoRA r=32
GRPO-Guard fixes importance-ratio bias at low-noise steps to prevent over-optimization
Design Position: Miles Diffusion vs LLM Miles vs Standalone flow_grpo
Enterprise two-plane RL shell adapted for flow-matching image generation post-training
Roadmap: Diffusion LLM RL + Omni RL - co-evolving with radixark/miles
Design Position (Miles enterprise RL shell + FlowGRPO algorithms + SGLang-D native diffusion rollout)
Decouple image rollout from FSDP train - swap rewards/algorithms via --*-path without touching engine code
Init: Ray PG - rollout_manager (sglang-d) - FSDP actor - update_weights - load flowgrpo_ocr prompts
Loop: generate images + log_probs - OCR/PickScore reward - GRPO train LoRA - weight sync - wandb log - repeat
Sources: github.com/radixark/miles_diffusion - train_diffusion.py - sglang_diffusion_rollout.py - flow_grpo README - Miles/slime arch
